blocks.text: TEHRAN, Iran — The United States struck Iran’s Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, hours after Tehran’s Revolutionary Guards said they had launched an attack on a base in Bahrain used by Washington. The strait — a key route for oil and gas shipments — has become the focus of the stalemated Middle East war, with the US military working to protect ships transiting the waterway in defiance of Iran’s attempts to close it. Open fighting in the war, which began in late February, has largely subsided, but no peace deal has been reached. The United States continues […]...
